products.description:
Execute M365→Google migrations with CloudM Migrate

CloudM Migrate is a common third-party engine for moving mail, files, and collaboration from Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace at scale. This solution is the CloudM execution playbook: configure the platform (hosted or self-hosted), connect M365 and Google, build the migration profile and user list, run scan/pre-stage and full/delta passes with throttling, and validate — so migrations complete reliably with minimal disruption.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python (Admin SDK / APIs).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the CloudM Migrate model (platform, connections, profiles, scan/pre-stage/delta), where it fits vs native + other tools, and the wave approach.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (CloudM platform + licensing, M365 + Google admin access/app registrations, user data, pilot scope).
  • Implementation Guide — configure the platform + connections, build the migration profile + user list, run scan/pre-stage + full/delta with throttling, validate, then scale waves — pilot-first; CloudM console internals + licensing deferred to CloudM docs, procedure and sequencing given.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or orchestration helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
  • Validation gates (pilot complete, delta clean, errors triaged) plus Best Practices for reliable cutover sequencing.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

M365→Google migrations completed reliably on CloudM — platform connected, profiles built, pre-stage and delta passes run and validated — minimal disruption at scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • assess-migration-readiness.py — read-only M365->Google migration readiness assessment
    • build-migration-userlist.py — build the source->destination user-list CSV CloudM consumes
    • check-migration-health.py — destination account/license + throttling health check between passes
    • plan-migration-waves.py — wave planner + throttling guidance for CloudM migration passes
    • validate-migration-report.py — post-migration validation report (item counts + permissions)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
